cases.fullTestName: portal return polls only within its bound and offers manual refresh
cases.decisionBeforeEdit: The failed baseline count was 4 (navigation reads plus first refresh); the later count was 6, with the second refresh pair and its entitlement/capacity reads dispatched about 1.1 seconds after the first pair. A 500ms transport-quiet window can finish before a clock-dispatched refresh has emitted its requests. Source CustomerPortalPanel clears the interval at its cutoff, and unchanged-code timer diagnostics alone and in the full recorded selection show the 31-second advance firing the interval then cutoff/clear at the same virtual time, with no timer firing or restart during the subsequent 60 seconds. This supports a fixture readiness race, not extending the polling contract. Explicitly await the provider-summary, entitlement and capacity responses from the final clock-dispatched refresh before recording the no-further-reads baseline. Preserve exact equality, cutoff, manual-refresh and capacity assertions. Instrumentation adds observation overhead; its green runs are diagnostic evidence, not final release qualification.
